notes: Body-free Coverage Registry of strategically relevant publishers and resources, whether or not they are currently onboarded Sources. This is not a complete census of the public web. Article bodies are never stored. Collection status is derived at runtime from sources.json and is not a stored score.

entries.notes: Cited in trusted Evidence (ev-italianberry-peru-varieties-2025, ev-italianberry-mbo-chile-2020) but not an actively collected Source. The cultivar-dense blackberry article that named Clara, Kalika, Equa, Furia, Nemus and others was found manually because this publisher was known-as-cited, not collected.
Google News is a redirect/search wrapper used by keyword Sources. It is not a publisher and must not be treated as collected coverage of any outlet that appears in search hits.
entries.exclusion_reason: Redirect host, not a publisher. Collecting or blocking it would disable keyword Sources rather than add a publisher.
